objective: Two independent research branches, literature support, current-data feasibility and concrete forward directions

requirements.literature: Both full reports contain primary URLs, reading scope, useful methods and limitations; 13 unique papers plus official docs
requirements.data_feasibility: Official gaze audit, whole-file inventory, per-window historical coverage, 21 fixed scene previews inspected
requirements.directions: Both reports define multi-stage pipelines, controls, metrics, failure paths and shared timestamp/object interfaces
requirements.preservation: 119 accessed source files unchanged; no training, label edits or baseline replacement; separate output directory

numeric_verification.scope: Arithmetic and read-only checks, not gaze accuracy, behavior labels, or independent event counts.

completion_scope: Preliminary investigation completed. Proposed downstream experiments remain future work, not unfinished promised runs.
